product_one_liner.value: Formalize provides compliance professionals with software to automate information security, GRC and privacy workflows and manage regulatory compliance, risks, audits and whistleblowing cases.

named_customers.notes: Arcano Partners appears in a Formalize case study; Zoios appears in testimonials for Whistleblower Software by Formalize.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 240 employees, and a company job posting describes a team of more than 200; the general careers page gives a rounded figure of 200.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains compliance guidance, regulatory analysis and product content, rather than qualifying engineering-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains dozens of articles for Formalize and its Whistleblower Software.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the 11 listed openings has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Formalize's AI Overview identifies Claude models and names Anthropic and AWS as the model developer and service provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center identifies its ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced on 2025-10-28 as a €30 million Series B; $35.1 million is PitchBook's reported USD amount.

raised_18mo.notes: Formalize announced its €30 million Series B on 2025-10-28, within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current jobs index includes a live Sales Development Representative – Norway posting.

launched_6mo.notes: The 2026-09-02 announcement introduces the Formalize Marketplace for partner-built compliance blueprints, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Stuart Wynn's profile lists a January 2026 start as Formalize's Chief Commercial Officer, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly requires logging customer interactions in its HubSpot CRM.
